newsitem.title: UK: Courtaulds bounces after in-line results.
newsitem.headline: Courtaulds bounces after in-line results.

text.p: Shares in chemicals group Courtaulds Plc rose on Wednesday, rebounding from recent weakness on the back of annual results which provided no fresh negative surprise, dealers said.
"The stock hit rock bottom and is having a bit of a recovery after 18 months of underperformance," said one dealer. "Perhaps the the worst is behind it and the stock was due a bounce."
Courtaulds shares were up 21p at 327-1/2 by 0956 GMT in volume of over two million shares, bouncing from the low of 305p set on Tuesday, its lowest in over five years.
Courtaulds posted a two percent rise in pre-tax profit to 134 million stg, compared with expectations mostly in a range between 130 million stg and 136 million.
Chief executive Gordon Campbell said he expected further progress this year, despite continued weakness in viscose and the strength of sterling.
